title: Eagles' Cam Jurgens says 'radiating' turf at Titans' field damaged his cleats; Nick Sirianni needed an IV

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Eagles' Cam Jurgens says 'radiating' turf at Titans' field damaged his cleats; Nick Sirianni needed an IV
sources.description: The conditions for Sunday's game raise some obvious concerns about the susceptibility of artificial turf to radiating heat and whether the NFL should be scheduling late summer games outdoors in the afternoon in southern cities.
